grading_contract.numeric: Parse integers, decimals, fractions and mixed numbers as exact rational values. Compare the complete value; never substring-match.

grading_contract.work: Only require non-whitespace content; do not grade the work.
grading_contract.time: Check day and time; midnight is 00:00, noon is 12:00.

selection_contract.shared_types: A type can belong to several lessons. Cross-lesson reuse is allowed.
selection_contract.selection: Filter types by lesson and difficulty, then choose one of the five materialized problems.
selection_contract.variants: Do not generate live AI questions for the initial app. Each type already includes four numerical variants.
